JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVI V.HOSMANI
ORAL JUDGMENT
With consent of learned counsel for parties, matter is taken up for disposal.

2. Heard Sri Laxmesh Putta Mataguppi, learned counsel for appellant and Sri SK Kayakamath,
learned counsel for respondent no.2-Insurer.
3.
Challenging judgment and award dated 21.06.2017 passed in MVC no.277/2012 by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Principal Senior Civil Judge, Haveri1, this appeal is filed.

4. Learned counsel for appellant submitted that while passing award, Tribunal merely noted contention of respondent that driver of appellant's vehicle held driving For short, 'Tribunal' NC:
2026:KHC-D:3395 HC-KAR licence for Light Motor Vehicle2 without Transport endorsement.
5.

But, in view of decision of Hon'ble Supreme Court in case of Mukund Dewangan v. Oriented Insurance Company Limited3, Tribunal would not be justified in fastening liability on owner and absolving Insurer.

entities.text: Mukund Dewangan v. Oriented Insurance Company Limited3
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Since, weight of Cruiser vehicle would be less than 7,500 kgs., Driving Licence for Sayed Roshan S/O. Akbersab Mulla vs M/S Netappa India Pvt Ltd on 4 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95831784/
2 LMV would be valid.
On said ground sought for allowing appeal.
6. Learned counsel for respondent no.2-Insurer opposed said submission.

7. Heard learned counsel for parties and perused impugned judgment and award.
8.

In view of decision of Hon'ble Supreme Court in case of Mukund Dewangan (supra) and as Driving Licence Extract at Ex.R1 as well as document No.1 produced along with Interim Application by appellant, Tribunal would not be For short, 'LMV' AIR 2017 SC 3668 NC: 2026:KHC-D:3395 HC-KAR justified in absolving Insurer from liability and appeal requires to be allowed.
9.

In view of above, following:
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed; judgment and award dated 21.06.2017 passed in MVC no.277/2012 by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Principal Senior Civil Judge,
Haveri, is modified.
Respondent no.2- Sriram General Insurance Company Limited is held liable to pay compensation assessed by Tribunal.
(ii) Respondent no.2 is directed to deposit compensation amount without six(6) weeks from today.
(iii) In view of allowing of owner's appeal, amount in deposit is ordered to be released in favour of appellant.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:3395 HC-KAR (iv)
In view of disposal of appeal, all applications are disposed off.

Sd/-
(RAVI V.HOSMANI) JUDGE SMM, CT:VP LIST NO.: 1 SL NO.: 10
